role: C-FIN-275 Software Engineering Intern, AI, Automation and Business Intelligence-EN
jd:
⠀

This position is exclusively open to students pursuing a university degree.

Internship dates: From January 4 to April 23 2027

Are you looking for a work environment where you can innovate, reach greater heights and collaborate with experts from a wide range of sectors? Would you like to join a world-class company and industry leader and contribute to projects you can be proud of? Come share your passion with us!

The Role We Are Offering You

By joining the Global Finance Systems and Support team, you will help improve the financial systems, business processes, reporting solutions and support services used across CAE’s global operations. You will contribute to practical initiatives selected according to business priorities, your technical aptitude and your learning objectives.

You will gain hands-on exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, SharePoint, Azure DevOps, Power BI and modern automation solutions. You will also receive mentorship from experienced professionals in enterprise software development, system integration, analytics and automation.

Are You Ready To

AI and Copilot agent development



- Contribute to the design and enhancement of AI-powered Copilot agents for business users and support teams. 
- Help connect AI and search experiences to key knowledge sources, including SharePoint documentation, training materials, support procedures, Azure DevOps work items, solution repositories and knowledge base articles. 
- Improve self-service capabilities by helping users find known solutions, troubleshooting guides, FAQs and previously resolved support issues. 
- Support feedback analysis and knowledge management practices to improve AI responses over time. 

Business process automation 



- Develop, maintain and optimize Power Automate workflows supporting Global Finance Support operations. 
- Automate business processes between SharePoint, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365 and other enterprise systems. 
- Design solutions that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery. 
- Troubleshoot and enhance existing workflows to improve scalability, performance and reliability. 
- Create automated approval processes, notifications, escalations and status-tracking mechanisms. 

SharePoint development and portal enhancement 



- Develop and enhance SharePoint-based business applications and service request portals. 
- Improve the usability, navigation and overall user experience of existing portals. 
- Implement new features supporting request management and operational workflows. 
- Develop forms, dashboards and interfaces that strengthen self-service capabilities. 
- Ensure information stored in SharePoint can be efficiently leveraged by AI-powered solutions. 

Azure DevOps integration and development 



- Develop and maintain integrations between SharePoint and Azure DevOps. 
- Automate the synchronization of requests, tickets, status updates, approvals and workflow activities. 
- Assist in developing solutions that allow AI tools to reference historical support tickets and issue resolutions. 
- Support process improvements related to support request management and software lifecycle activities. 

Power BI reporting and analytics 



- Design and develop Power BI dashboards and operational reports that provide visibility into support workload, ticket aging, request volumes, service performance, open requests and the impact of automation and AI initiatives. 
- Build reports using information captured in SharePoint, Azure DevOps and other business systems. 
- Create reporting solutions that support operational and management decision-making. 

Knowledge management and continuous improvement 



- Help establish and maintain centralized repositories of support knowledge and best practices. 
- Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and analytics to improve support efficiency. 
- Assist in documenting solutions, workflows, development standards and operational procedures. 
- Support initiatives aimed at reducing repetitive support requests through improved access to knowledge.

Our Ideal Candidate Has



- Basic programming knowledge and a strong interest in software development, automation, AI, analytics or enterprise applications. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
- The ability to learn new technologies quickly and collaborate with business and technical teams. 
- A curious, organized and collaborative approach, with an interest in working as part of a team in a professional environment. 
- Proficiency in English, which is required for collaboration in a global finance environment. French is considered a strong asset, particularly when interacting with local stakeholders in Montréal. 
- The ability to meet security clearance and system-access authorization requirements throughout the internship. 

Experience or exposure to the following is considered an asset:



- Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps and Power BI. 
- SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps or Copilot Studio. 
- Data modelling, business intelligence, analytics or dashboard development. 
- AI fundamentals, prompt engineering, knowledge management, or search and retrieval technologies. 
- Academic, personal or professional projects involving programming, system integration, automation or data visualization. 

Preferred Education



- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field. 
- Completion of at least one to two years of undergraduate studies. 

Location of the internship is Montreal

Internship will be carried out in hybrid mode (2 days/week minimum)



- All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada and must meet the requirements of the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP). All hires will be required to complete, sign and return the Controlled Goods Program form within a week of its transmittal. They must also provide a copy of their passport or birth certificate. All students with a work permit must provide a copy of it and a police clearance certificate from the country or countries where they have resided in the past five years.
- Please take note that if you are on a student, work or international student permit, the delays for the security background check take minimum 16 weeks.

CAE Offers



- Salary determined according to the number of years and / or cumulative credits 
- Flexible schedules and work from home policy 
- Open concept workspace 
- Opportunity to work on a variety of projects on a multidisciplinary team 
- Possibility of permanent employment/extension 
- STM access on campus 
- Free parking on site for cars and bikes 
- Running club and sports activities 
- Changing rooms and showers 
- Panoramic terrace open during Summer and Fall 
- For all interns hired, we will reimburse the internship costs for up to $250 per intern upon presentation of supporting documents.

About CAE

At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

Position Type 

COOP-Student (Fixed Term)

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CAE is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, veteran status, age, or other characteristics protected by law. We encourage applicants who may not meet every qualification to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available—contact your recruiter or email CAECarrieres-Careers@cae.com if needed.

Data Privacy

Privacy Statement | CAE

As part of our process, we may use AI‑supported tools to help review applications, with human decision‑making at every step. CAE thanks all applicants for their interest. However, only those whose background and experience match the requirements of the role will be contacted.

Vestmark is looking for a motivated Cloud Engineer Intern or Co-op (2027 Spring Semester)  starting in January 2027 to join the Platform Engineering team.    

 The Platform Engineering Team is responsible for the design, provisioning, monitoring, and operation of the hardware, networks, databases, and cloud services that support the VestmarkONE SaaS Platform. The team offers a great opportunity to experience a wide range of technologies and challenges as we strive to provide world-class hosted services to our growing customer base. Scalability, security, and service optimization are the fundamental challenges the team takes on every day. The team focuses heavily on AWS cloud deployments for new and current customers, as well as troubleshooting cloud services with internal application engineers.   

 As a Cloud Engineer Intern, you will work on the client infrastructure implementation and deployment team, partnering closely with other cloud and systems engineers to learn how deployments use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision services and infrastructure in AWS. You will help validate cloud infrastructure setup and connectivity.   

 Responsibilities   

• Work with the team to deploy and validate new cloud infrastructure for development, testing, and production purposes.   

• Learn and understand cloud architecture and contribute ideas during design and planning sessions.   

• Assist senior engineers in knowledge transfer and process workflow efforts with other teams.   

• Troubleshoot issues across the cloud stack and contribute to their resolution.   

• Participate in design reviews of cloud architecture and performance optimization.   

• Create and maintain technical documentation of processes related to daily tasks and project work.   
 
 Qualifications   

• Working towards a BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.   

• Experience writing technical documentation.   

• Experience with cloud services such as AWS or Azure.   

 Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)   

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.   

• Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Windows Server and SQL Server.   

• Familiarity with network technologies including VLAN, HTTP(S), SSL/TLS, and SFTP.   

• Familiarity with SaaS applications.   

 Equal Opportunity Statement   

 Vestmark is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Vestmark prohibits employment discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability status, protected military or veteran status, and genetic information.   

 Compensation   

 Hourly compensation ranges from $19-$22, with specific rate determined by academic year level.

Vestmark prohibits employment discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability status, protected military or veteran status, and genetic information.

Syntiant Corp., a leader in the high-growth AI software and semiconductor solutions space, is looking for a DevOps Machine Learning Infrastructure Intern to take on a role supporting our Software Engineering team.
  
 The DevOps Intern will work alongside engineers to help build, maintain, and enhance our machine learning applications, specifically those deployed on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and on-premises machine learning cluster. The ideal candidate will have experience with application development, cloud infrastructure, containerization, and DevOps practices, as well as the ability to work on both on-premises and cloud environments.

• Develop, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI. 
• Deploy & manage applications on AWS EKS, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance. 
• Integrate with various data sources & services (e.g., MongoDB, Postgres) for efficient data storage and retrieval. 
• Implement CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes. 
• Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration of cloud-native tools and practices. 
• Maintain on-premises servers running Ceph, PostgreSQL, and NFS services. 
• Troubleshoot & resolve issues across different environments (development, staging, production). 
• Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing sessions 
 Qualifications 
 
• Candidate pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with relevant coursework, research, or project experience. 
• Proficiency in Python, with familiarity using FastAPI for API development. 
• Exposure to AWS EKS, including deploying, scaling, and managing Kubernetes clusters is a plus. 
• Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure services such as S3, RDS, and VPCs. 
• Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins. 
• Familiarity with database systems, including MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and NFS. 
• Exposure to on-premises storage solutions like Ceph. 
• Familiarity with Linux system administration. 
• Willingness to learn to write clean, maintainable code and perform thorough testing. 
• Strong problem-solving skills and a strong attention to detail. 
• Exposure to cloud-native observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus. 
• Familiarity with Kubernetes operators and Helm charts is a plus. 
• Exposure to container orchestration on-premises using K8s or similar technologies is a plus. 
• Exposure to DevOps best practices and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.

About Syntiant : 
  
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, Calif., Syntiant Corp. is a leader in delivering hardware and software solutions for edge AI deployment. The company’s purpose-built silicon and hardware-agnostic models are being deployed globally to power edge AI speech, audio, sensor and vision applications across a wide range of consumer and industrial use cases, from earbuds to automobiles. Syntiant’s advanced chip solutions merge deep learning with semiconductor design to produce ultra-low-power, high performance, deep neural network processors. Syntiant also provides compute-efficient software solutions with proprietary model architectures that enable world-leading inference speed and minimized memory footprint across a broad range of processors. The company is backed by several of the world’s leading strategic and financial investors including Intel Capital, Microsoft’s M12, Applied Ventures, Bosch Ventures, the Amazon Alexa Fund, and Atlantic Bridge Capital. More information on the company can be found by visiting  www.syntiant.com .
fit_why: DevOps/infra focus, Python and Docker overlap, no Kubernetes or Ceph experience

At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


Team
We are a group of researchers building agentic AI systems for a diverse range of applications, including robotics, vehicle design, factory logistics, and numerical optimization.

About the Internship
A successful candidate would have a background in both agentic AI and one of the above applications.
This is an opportunity to apply your knowledge to novel research questions and work towards a publication with professional researchers.  The internship will be in our Cambridge office and includes competitive compensation befitting the challenging but fun nature of the research work at TRI.


Responsibilities :
• 
 Undertake a well-scoped research project in a relevant area and bring it to publication in an appropriate venue.  

• 
 Define project scope and agree on project direction with your mentor.

Qualifications:
• 
 Current Ph.D. student in related fields - ML/AI, optimization, computer science,  applied mathematics, or similar.

• 
 Publication background in relevant venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIOPT, Math Programming).

• 
 Experience with training and fine tuning foundation models with reinforcement learning.

• 
 Proficient at using agentic workflows to accelerate research explorations and experiments.

role: AI Labs Summer Internship, Emerging Talent
jd:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Fixed Term & Temporary 
 Job Details 

 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

 The Experience 

 Build at enterprise scale. Launch like a founder. Start this summer.

 Salesforce AI Labs is seeking exceptional emerging AI and computer science talent for our highly selective, 12-week summer internship designed to develop the next generation of AI builders.

 As an AI Labs intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded in one of four disciplines, tackling real technical, product, or customer challenges, building with frontier AI technologies, and contributing to solutions at enterprise scale. You'll work alongside experienced researchers, engineers, product managers, and technical leaders, with access to AI-native development tools and opportunities to take meaningful ownership of your work.

 Interns will be placed in one of four disciplines:
 
• Build (Product Engineering): Design, build, and ship AI-powered products, developing technical expertise in production-scale engineering. 
• Shape (Product Management): Translate customer needs into product strategy, define priorities, and help shape the next generation of AI products. 
• Deliver (FDE / Builders): Work with teams developing and deploying AI solutions that solve real-world customer challenges. 
• Transform (DET / Customer Zero): Reimagine enterprise workflows and operations, leveraging AI to drive transformation at scale. 
 While you'll spend the summer gaining hands-on experience in one discipline, you'll also collaborate with interns across the other three disciplines on a cross-functional capstone project. Together, you'll bring engineering, product strategy, customer solutions, and enterprise transformation perspectives to a shared AI challenge, culminating in a final presentation at Demo Day.

 The internship provides an opportunity to build technical depth, develop a broader understanding of the AI lifecycle, and experience how cross-functional teams bring innovative solutions to life.

 This internship is designed as a feeder into the 24-month AI Labs Rotational Fellowship, where Fellows complete four six-month rotations across Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform. Interns who demonstrate strong performance and potential may be considered for full-time opportunities in the Fellowship following graduation.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 
 
• Build and Deliver AI Solutions: Spend 12 weeks embedded in one AI Labs discipline, contributing to meaningful projects that solve real technical, product, or customer challenges. 
• Work with Frontier AI: Gain hands-on experience with AI-native development tools, AI agents, and emerging technologies to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving. 
• Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner with interns from Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform on a cross-functional capstone project, combining different perspectives to develop an innovative AI solution. 
• Own Meaningful Work: Take ownership of assigned projects, from problem definition and experimentation through development and delivery, with guidance from experienced AI Labs leaders. 
• Present Your Work: Showcase your team's capstone project at an in-person Demo Day, presenting your solution, approach, and impact to an executive panel. 
• Learn from AI Leaders: Engage with engineering, product, FDE, and DET teams through mentorship, workshops, and cohort experiences that broaden your understanding of the AI lifecycle. 
 You're Our Person If... 
 
• Computer Science & Engineering Fundamentals: Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and technical problem-solving. 
• Practical Coding Experience: Experience developing software through academic projects, research, internships, or independent technical projects. 
• Programming: Proficiency in Python and experience building software, AI, or machine learning applications. 
• AI & ML Foundations: Understanding of core AI/ML concepts and experience using modern AI development tools to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving. 
• Builder Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity, high ownership, and ability to solve complex problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. 
• Collaboration & Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Even Better If... 
 
• Proven Build History: Portfolio evidence of building, deploying, or open-sourcing software or AI applications through projects, research, hackathons, or public repositories. 
• Applied AI Experience: Previous internship, research, or project experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, product development, or solutions architecture. 
• Cross-Functional Experience: Experience working across engineering, product, design, or customer-facing teams to solve complex problems. 
• Cloud & Data Pipelines: Exposure to cloud infrastructure, scalable data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL), or MLOps pipelines for model deployment. 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
